description: This header file declares functions and structures related to interactive rebase operations, such as appending help messages, editing todo lists, and checking todo list consistency.

methods.name: append_todo_help
methods.description: Provides help information for specific rebase commands.

methods.name: edit_todo_list
methods.description: Allows editing of the rebase todo list, with parameters for repository context and options.

methods.name: todo_list_check
methods.description: Checks the integrity or validity of a todo list against another.

methods.name: todo_list_check_against_backup
methods.description: Validates the current todo list against a backup, considering repository and replay options.
